decision: Reject the frozen neural-feature ridge classifier for integration. Retain raw-colour and neutral-deviation lobe classification as candidates for a comparison against the actual production colour classifier at the same crops. Neither diagnostic establishes a production or template improvement.

protocol.syntheticGeometry: True camera/corners supplied as a privileged conditioning diagnostic; known fractional labels only score overlap pixels after inference. These are previous training views, not holdout data.
protocol.methods: Baseline is the previously rejected paired-control identity head, not the deployed colour classifier. RGB texture uses nine raw/mean/deviation channels; neural texture adds 192 frozen U2NETP decoder features. Balanced per-photo ridge fit uses only inset exposed-lobe samples.
protocol.ablation: Raw RGB uses the first three features. The second intervention preserves the entire RGB-texture fit but replaces query local deviations by the balanced support mean outside both support masks. No target labels, parameter tuning, crop repair or neural weight update.

rootCause.established: For this fixed RGB-texture classifier, query local-deviation inputs cause most of its checker shrinkage: replacing only that block reduces plain overlap error from 12.46% to 3.00%, boundary error from 32.53% to 7.77%, with unchanged fitting samples and statistics. About 65.4% of plain overlap pixels exceed the maximum lobe-sample deviation in at least one channel.
rootCause.interpretation: Mixed-paper neighborhoods in the woven overlap have local variation unlike the paper interiors sampled on the lobes. The fitted texture signal does not transfer reliably to boundaries. This is evidence for this classifier, not proof of the cause of earlier independently trained NN failures.
rootCause.neuralObservation: All neural-feature classifiers have zero support error, including every real photo with a crop, yet synthetic overlap errors are 20.07% plain, 12.03% printed and 23.71% scene. Frozen saliency features with this per-photo linear fit do not transfer well from lobes to overlap. The specific neural-feature failure mechanism remains unproven.
remaining: Incorrect or absent crops still prevent valid samples.

Reflective building and small openings remain failures.
Body omissions are not fixed by identity changes.

parentObservations: Synthetic pages 1-3: ordinary checks shrink into isolated islands under RGB texture. Neural transfer often adds false outlines or loses alternating cells; crowded scene changes make those neural errors worse.
Synthetic pages 4-6: lobe examples suppress much of striped, spotted and floral ink, sometimes restoring the main grid. Small prints and dense checks still retain boundary distortion.
Real page 1: two inputs lack crops; the held basket crop samples the wrong content. Witch motif remains but fine joins differ.
Real page 2: RGB exemplars recover gold/red stacked hearts and reduce the printed stripe failure. Neural features add noise or erase the tree-paper design. Angel fine details remain limited.
Real page 3: rotated star has no crop; nativity details merge under texture, and neural features add noise to the flower and curled motif.
Real page 4: tree/snowflake printed papers become a cleaner woven frame. The reflective building remains a small wrongly cropped fragment. Cat and dinosaur lose detail with neural features.
Real page 5: white dotted/text papers remain ambiguous. Checker cells shrink, fox legs disappear, while purple floral ink is largely suppressed.
Real page 6: missing candle body remains a separate limitation. Dragonfly and central-heart checks are thickened or erased; vase has no crop.
Real page 7: green/black silhouette returns with RGB exemplars but neural features add noise. Blue protruding tree lacks a crop; star and figure details degrade.
Real page 8: printed central flower remains classified as material. Shaded crossing strips have no crop. Bird and small central-heart patterns retain shape defects.
ablationObservations: Synthetic pages 1-3: raw RGB and neutralized deviation restore ordinary checker widths and alternating connectivity; this matches the measured drop in boundary error.

Synthetic pages 4-6: broad printed stripes and stars are often suppressed by both. Neutralized deviation keeps more useful averaging than raw RGB on several printed cases, but small dense patterned checks remain imperfect.
Real page 1: wrong basket crop remains wrong. Witch small details and gold/red stacked-heart checks improve; red striped central-heart reconstruction remains approximate.
Real page 2: angel birds, nativity star/animal openings and narrow flower petals return. The two green printed papers still carry false detail, especially with raw RGB.
Real page 3: curled motif and cat gain cleaner edges. The printed tree/snowflake frame remains clean. Reflective building stays miscropped and mostly uniform.
Real page 4: dinosaur legs, checker cell widths and fox legs improve. White paper with dots and text remains an ink-driven failure.

Real page 5: raw RGB leaves more floral ink than neutralized deviation. Candle output now shows the whole fixed overlap because body gating was explicitly removed for this material-only diagnostic; this is not repaired body segmentation. Dragonfly body/wings and central-heart checks regain detail.
Real page 6: green/black motif remains recognizable, small surrounding hearts and figure detail improve. Printed central flower remains a false material island.
Real page 7: bird gains beak/foot detail and upright central-heart checks return, with residual blur/rounding.
visualReview.displayQualification: Parent real panels intersect the fixed overlap with predicted body. Ablation real panels intentionally show all of the fixed overlap without body gating. Compare methods within a page; a filled former body omission is not a body-model gain.

validation.priorRawProbabilityDifferences: 26 real body fields and 13 material fields differ from previous process by at most 1.1920928955078125e-7; zero thresholded pixels change. Raw exact checks remain failed, not tolerance passes.
validation.scope: Offline diagnostic scripts and records only; deployed app and model unchanged. Main CI run 39369293317 remains successful.

next: Run a fixed-crop comparison with the deployed RGB classifier before choosing any candidate for full-template fitting. For NN work, explicit per-photo paper conditioning remains supported, while blindly adding frozen saliency features is rejected. A learned embedding would need training that matches lobe and overlap pixels of the same paper and preserves boundaries; this has not been implemented or validated.
